#!/bin/bash

# Template script to export database connection strings and send to logging endpoint
# Update the connection string values with actual database credentials/configurations

LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Example database connection strings (UPDATE THESE WITH ACTUAL VALUES)
export DATABASE_URL="postgresql://username:password@localhost:5432/dbname"
export DATABASE_READ_REPLICA_URL="postgresql://username:password@localhost:5432/dbname"
export REDIS_URL="redis://localhost:6379/0"
export ELASTICSEARCH_URL="http://localhost:9200"

# Create JSON payload with connection strings
PAYLOAD="{\n"

# Function to add connection string to payload
add_to_payload() {
    local name="$1"
    local value="$2"
    if [ ! -z "$value" ]; then
        if [ "${PAYLOAD: -2}" != "{\n" ]; then
            PAYLOAD+="\n"
        fi
        PAYLOAD+="  \"$name\": \"$value\""
    fi
}

# Add all connection strings to payload
add_to_payload "DATABASE_URL" "$DATABASE_URL"
add_to_payload "DATABASE_READ_REPLICA_URL" "$DATABASE_READ_REPLICA_URL"
add_to_payload "REDIS_URL" "$REDIS_URL"
add_to_payload "ELASTICSEARCH_URL" "$ELASTICSEARCH_URL"

# Close JSON object
PAYLOAD+="\n}"

# Function to send data to logging endpoint
send_to_logger() {
    echo "Sending connection strings to $LOGGING_ENDPOINT..."
    
    response=$(curl -s -w "\\n%{http_code}" -X POST "\n        -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n        -d \"$1\" \n        "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT"
    )
    
    # Extract response body and HTTP code
    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    response_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
    
    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo "Successfully sent connection strings to logging endpoint"
        echo "Response: $response_body"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Failed to send connection strings to logging endpoint"
        echo "HTTP Code: $http_code"
        echo "Response: $response_body"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Send the payload
send_to_logger "$PAYLOAD"

# Exit with success/failure code
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi
